prompt: Some people think watching television is a good way to relax. Others prefer other activities. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, many people like to relax in their free time. Some people think that watching television is the best way to relax. However, other people prefer to do different activities like sports or reading. In this essay, I will discuss both sides and give my opinion.

On the one hand, watching TV is very popular for many reasons. First, it is very easy and cheap. People can just sit on the sofa after a hard day at work and turn on the television. They do not need to move or spend money. Second, there are many types of programs on TV, such as movies, news, and sports. For example, people can watch funny shows to feel happy and forget their daily stress. Therefore, watching TV is a good way to relax at home.

On the other hand, some people prefer other activities because they think TV is boring or unhealthy. First, sitting for a long time in front of a screen is bad for the eyes and the body. Instead, people like to go outside and do physical exercise, like walking or playing football. Exercise is good for health and gives people more energy. Second, doing hobbies like reading books or meeting friends can help people make strong relationships and learn new things, which is better than just watching TV.

In conclusion, watching TV is an easy and comfortable way to relax at home after work. However, I believe that doing other active hobbies like playing sports or spending time with friends is better for physical and mental health.
